capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: 78.1 kWh nominal, LG 5L NMC (EV Database); Wikipedia lists 78.1 kWh for Premium RWD/AWD. EV Database Highland LR RWD (78.1/75) and KBB US 2026 Premium 75 kWh. The 2027 Premium RWD range (584 km) equals the NMC Long Range RWD (584 km), not the LFP Premium-I (463 km; OpenEV 60/57 LFP, a Canadian import), so the NMC pack is chosen; not confirmed on a manufacturer page.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla's release note (2020.24.6.4, Model S/3/X/Y) says the car preconditions its battery when navigating to a fast charger; this is a software feature delivered to the whole Model 3 line (2027 Premium RWD). Page mentions no manual battery-warming control. A manual control was neither found nor ruled out: Tesla's owner's manual pages were blocked (403) and scheduled-departure preconditioning in search excerpts is cabin-oriented.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists 11 kW AC for the Highland Long Range/Performance (EU, 3-phase) and the existing OpenEV data on the 2026 Canadian cars also shows 11 kW; Wikipedia infobox says 11.5 kW (48 A) for Long Range; Tesla does not publish a Highland AC figure (InsideEVs).
